payload.message:
Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Jordan planning proposal: strict m015 Doctor’s appointment attend full [0,1). For soft meetings, to avoid self-overlap I’m leaning: m005 Volleyball [4,5), m009 Friends hangout [5,6), m013 Study group [6,8), m007 Study group [8,9), m016 Board game night [9,10), m003 Gaming [10,11), m001 Swimming [11,14). Skip overlapping alternatives m011/m014/m004 around 5-9, plus m012 and m008. This creates a continuous non-overlapping chain maximizing overlap opportunities. If others can align on these windows, especially Quinn/Taylor/Reese/Riley/Avery, reward should be good. Feedback welcome.

Taylor planning proposal: for strict m015 I plan full attendance [0,1). For soft meetings, to avoid self-overlap and maximize shared overlaps, I’m leaning to Jordan’s chain on my meetings: m005 Volleyball [4,5), m009 Friends hangout [5,6), m013 Study group [6,8), m007 Study group [8,9), m016 Board game night [9,10), m003 Gaming [10,11). Likely skip m010, m011, m006, m012, m008 to keep a clean non-overlapping path; m002 maybe skip unless others strongly prefer [1,2) or [0,1) but that conflicts with strict doctor at [0,1). If Quinn/Avery/Reese/Riley can align on overlapping slices in these meetings, seems strong. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese planning: I can align with the proposed non-overlapping soft chain on my meetings. Current preference: m002 Study group [0,2) (since I have no strict conflict), then m005 Volleyball [4,5), m009 Friends hangout [5,6), choose one of {m011 Swimming [6,8), m004 Art [6,8), m014 Gym [6,8)} depending on where others concentrate, then m007 Study group [8,9), m016 Board game [9,10), m003 Gaming [10,11), and likely m001 Swimming [11,14). I would skip overlapping alternatives including m008 unless there’s a strong push. My main open question is the 6-8 block: Jordan/Taylor suggested a study group m013 that I’m not in, so for Reese the best substitute is one of m011/m004/m014. If Quinn/Avery/Riley have preferences, I’m happy to match one shared option there.

Quinn planning proposal: I support the common non-overlapping chain anchored by strict m015 Doctor’s appointment full [0,1). For my soft meetings, tentative plan is m002 Study group [1,2) (to avoid overlap with m015 while still catching others who can attend then), m010 Friends’ hangout [2,4), m005 Volleyball [4,5), then for the 5-9 block I prefer concentrating on m004 Collaborative art workshop [5,8) and then m007 Study group [8,9). After that m016 Board game night [9,10), m003 Gaming [10,11), and m001 Swimming [11,14). I would skip overlapping alternatives m011/m014/m013/m012/m008. Main coordination question: can Avery/Reese/Riley/Jordan also favor m004 over m011/m014 in the 5-8 block? If so, that seems a good shared choice for participants common to that meeting.

Riley planning: I can mostly align with the emerging non-overlapping chain. Tentative for my meetings: m002 Study group [1,2), m010 Friends’ hangout [2,4), m005 Volleyball [4,5), then in the 5-9 block I favor m004 Collaborative art workshop [5,8) (shared with Quinn/Reese/Avery/Jordan/Riley) over m011/m014/m009, then m007 Study group [8,9), m012 Lunch [9,10), m003 Gaming [10,11), and m001 Swimming [11,14). I’d likely skip m006, m008, m009, m011, m014 to avoid self-overlap. Main question: can Avery/Jordan/Reese also support m004 [5,8) and m012 [9,10) for coordination? This seems to give me broad overlap without conflicts. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Avery planning: I’ll definitely take strict m015 Doctor’s appointment full [0,1). For soft meetings, to avoid self-overlap I’m leaning to: m002 Study group [1,2), m010 Friends’ hangout [2,4), then for the 5-8 block I support concentrating on m004 Collaborative art workshop [5,8) (instead of m011/m014), then m007 Study group [8,9), m016 Board game night [9,10), and m001 Swimming [11,14). I would skip m011, m014, m013, and likely m006 to keep a clean chain. One open question is 4-5: I’m only in m011 starting at 4, but if most others are on m005 Volleyball [4,5) I may just skip 4-5 rather than fragment attendance. This plan aligns well with Quinn/Riley and gives strong overlap in shared meetings. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan update after reading everyone: I’m willing to revise my earlier 5-9 plan to better match the majority. New tentative plan for my meetings: m015 Doctor full [0,1); m005 Volleyball [4,5); then favor m004 Collaborative art workshop [5,8) (instead of m009/m011/m013/m014) because Quinn/Riley/Avery support it and Reese can join there too; then m007 Study group [8,9); for 9-10 I can do m016 Board game night [9,10) rather than m012 since Avery/Quinn/Reese/Taylor are there; then m003 Gaming [10,11); then m001 Swimming [11,14). I’d skip m002, m009, m011, m012, m013, m014, m008 under this coordinated version. This seems to create strong overlap with many participants while staying non-overlapping. Any objections or better tweaks?

Taylor update: after seeing majority support, I’m revising my tentative plan to better match the group chain. Current preference for my meetings: m015 Doctor full [0,1); skip m002 and m010; m005 Volleyball [4,5); m009 Friends hangout [5,6) unless we want to consolidate harder on m004/m011 alternatives (I’m not in m004, so m009 still seems best for me at 5-6); m013 Study group [6,8); m007 Study group [8,9); m016 Board game [9,10); m003 Gaming [10,11); skip m011, m006, m012, m008. This keeps me non-overlapping and aligns with Jordan on all our shared later meetings, plus overlaps with others at 4-5, 8-11. If anyone especially wants overlap with me in m009 [5,6) or m013 [6,8), let me know.

Reese update: I support the emerging coordinated chain on my meetings. Tentative final plan for Reese is m002 Study group [1,2) (to overlap Quinn/Riley/Avery and avoid idle 0-1 if possible), m005 Volleyball [4,5), m004 Collaborative art workshop [5,8) as the consensus choice for the 5-8 block, m007 Study group [8,9), m016 Board game night [9,10), m003 Gaming [10,11), and m001 Swimming [11,14). I would skip m009, m011, m014, m006, and m008 to avoid self-overlap and consolidate overlap. This aligns well with Quinn/Riley/Avery/Jordan on m004/m007/m016/m003/m001. Taylor won’t be in m004 but still matches at 4-5 and 8-11. Any objections?

Quinn update: I’m happy with the emerging consensus and plan to commit a non-overlapping chain on my meetings as follows: m015 Doctor [0,1) full; m002 Study group [1,2); m010 Friends’ hangout [2,4); m005 Volleyball [4,5); m004 Collaborative art workshop [5,8); m007 Study group [8,9); m016 Board game night [9,10); m003 Gaming [10,11); m001 Swimming [11,14). I’ll skip m011, m014, m013, m012, and m008. This aligns with Avery/Riley/Reese/Jordan on most shared meetings; Taylor differs mainly in the 5-8 block but still overlaps at 4-5 and 8-11. Unless anyone sees a better tweak, I’m ready to execute this in the next phase. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Riley update: I support the consensus non-overlapping chain and am likely to commit the following on my meetings in execution: m002 [1,2), m010 [2,4), m005 [4,5), m004 [5,8), m007 [8,9), m012 [9,10), m003 [10,11), m001 [11,14); skip m006, m008, m009, m011, m014. Note m012 [9,10) is my best available 9-10 meeting (I’m not in m016), so Jordan/Quinn/Taylor if you want overlap with me there, please consider m012 [9,10) instead of alternatives; otherwise I still think this chain is best for me overall.

Avery update: I’m good with the consensus chain and expect to execute on my meetings as follows: m015 Doctor [0,1) full; m002 Study group [1,2); m010 Friends’ hangout [2,4); skip m011 at [4,8) so I can instead do m004 Collaborative art workshop [5,8); then m007 Study group [8,9); skip m006; m016 Board game night [9,10); skip m013 and m014; m001 Swimming [11,14). This leaves 4-5 idle for me, but avoids conflicts and maximizes overlap on the larger shared meetings with Quinn/Reese/Riley/Jordan, plus Taylor at 8-10 and 11-14 absent his meeting set. Unless anyone sees a better Avery-specific tweak, I’m ready for execution next phase. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan final planning note before execution: I intend to commit m015 Doctor [0,1) full; m005 Volleyball [4,5); m004 Collaborative art workshop [5,8); m007 Study group [8,9); m016 Board game night [9,10); m003 Gaming [10,11); m001 Swimming [11,14). I’ll skip m002, m009, m011, m012, m013, m014, m008. This matches the main group consensus and stays non-overlapping. Riley, I see your m012 [9,10) preference, but for Jordan m016 [9,10) still seems better because it overlaps with Avery/Quinn/Reese/Taylor; we’ll still align again at 10-11 and 11-14. Ready to execute next phase unless something changes.

Reese final planning confirmation: I’m aligned with the consensus non-overlapping chain and expect to execute m002 [1,2), m005 [4,5), m004 [5,8), m007 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m003 [10,11), m001 [11,14); skip m009, m011, m014, m006, and m008. This gives me broad overlap with Quinn/Avery/Jordan/Riley on most shared meetings and with Taylor at 4-5 and 8-11. Ready for execution next phase.

Avery final planning confirmation: I’m sticking with the consensus non-overlapping plan for my meetings and expect to execute m015 Doctor [0,1) full; m002 Study group [1,2); m010 Friends’ hangout [2,4); skip m011 [4,8); m004 Collaborative art workshop [5,8); m007 Study group [8,9); skip m006; m016 Board game night [9,10); skip m013 and m014; m001 Swimming [11,14). This keeps me conflict-free and aligned with Quinn/Reese/Jordan/Riley on the main shared chain. Ready for execution next phase.

Taylor final planning confirmation: I expect to execute the following non-overlapping plan on my meetings unless something changes in execution: m015 Doctor [0,1) full; skip m002 and m010; m005 Volleyball [4,5); m009 Friends’ hangout [5,6); m013 Study group [6,8); m007 Study group [8,9); m016 Board game night [9,10); m003 Gaming [10,11); skip m011, m006, m012, and m008. This preserves my best available chain, aligns with Jordan exactly on our shared later meetings, and overlaps with the broader group at 4-5 and 8-11. Ready for execution next phase.

Quinn final planning confirmation: no objections from me. I’m sticking with the consensus non-overlapping plan for execution: m015 Doctor [0,1) full; m002 [1,2); m010 [2,4); m005 [4,5); m004 [5,8); m007 [8,9); m016 [9,10); m003 [10,11); m001 [11,14); skip m011, m014, m013, m012, m008. This should give strong overlap with Avery/Jordan/Reese/Riley on most shared meetings, and with Taylor at 4-5 and 8-11. Ready for execution next phase. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Avery planning status: no change from my final confirmation. For execution I intend m015 [0,1), m002 [1,2), m010 [2,4), m004 [5,8), m007 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m001 [11,14); skip m011, m006, m013, m014. This remains conflict-free and aligned with the main group chain. Ready to execute next phase.
